note: Every form of a given name, by language, with whether an archive has met it on a record. Built from data/given-name-families.json; nothing about a person is kept. A form with seen 0 is a lookup aid, not a finding.

languages.label: Latin
languages.note: The language of the register itself: the name as the priest wrote it in the entry, in the nominative or the case the sentence needed.

languages.label: Italian
languages.note: What a civil clerk in Italy or under Italian administration wrote.

languages.label: Venetian
languages.note: The Venetian of the Adriatic clerks and of the street, often a clipped form.

languages.label: Croatian
languages.note: What the family said at home, and what a Croatian-language register wrote.

languages.label: German
languages.note: The Austrian and German form, from the administration and from emigration papers.

languages.label: Hungarian
languages.note: What a Hungarian-administered register or index wrote.

languages.label: English
languages.note: The form at arrival: what an English-language clerk, ship's list or index made of it.
